theme.vibe: Whimsical, Scholarly, Cozy, Magical Academy, Child-friendly, RPG
theme.description: A cute, colorful chibi-style educational RPG for Grades K-2. The design must be bright, readable, friendly, and soft. No sharp edges, no dark/scary elements.

background.description: Soft ivory/cream. Never use pure white for the main app background.

primary.description: Magical Soft Lavender. Used for primary actions, magic elements, and brand identity.

secondary.description: Sage Green. Represents nature, Meadowfall Grove, and safe progression.

accent.description: Soft Gold for stars/coins/academy accents. Fire/Earth used specifically for elemental companions.

text.description: Soft Charcoal. Do not use pure #000000 as it's too harsh for kids.

typography.strategy: Soft Utility + Youth Brand (Highly legible, bouncy, rounded)

scales.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-main

layout_spacing.strategy: Generous, Over-sized touch targets. Kids lack motor precision.

button.primary: bg-[#9D8DF1] text-white font-heading text-xl py-4 px-8 rounded-full shadow-[0_6px_0_#7A6AC6] hover:brightness-110 active:translate-y-[6px] active:shadow-none transition-all
button.secondary: bg-[#86A789] text-white font-heading text-xl py-4 px-8 rounded-full shadow-[0_6px_0_#6A8A6D] hover:brightness-110 active:translate-y-[6px] active:shadow-none transition-all
button.gold: bg-[#F4C753] text-[#4A4A4A] font-heading text-xl py-4 px-8 rounded-full shadow-[0_6px_0_#DDAE3B] hover:brightness-110 active:translate-y-[6px] active:shadow-none transition-all
button.outline: bg-white text-[#9D8DF1] border-4 border-[#9D8DF1] font-heading text-xl py-3 px-7 rounded-full shadow-[0_6px_0_#9D8DF1] active:translate-y-[6px] active:shadow-none transition-all

card.base: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md rounded-[32px] border-4 border-white/60 shadow-xl shadow-indigo-900/5
card.interactive: hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-indigo-900/10 transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer

companion_avatar.strategy: CSS Shapes + Emojis inside stacked div circles. Outer ring: Elemental color. Inner circle: Lighter tint. Center: Emoji + SVG Face.

progress_bar.container: h-6 bg-gray-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden border-2 border-gray-200 inset-shadow-sm
progress_bar.fill: h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#9D8DF1] to-[#F4C753] transition-all duration-500 ease-out

motion.hover: Spring-based scale-up (scale-105) for cards and buttons
motion.feedback: Wiggle animation on correct answers, subtle shake on incorrect
motion.page_transition: Fade in and slide up from 10px below
motion.eggs: Pulse and gentle wobble on the Hatchery page

media.instruction: Use these generated images as the backgrounds for the respective screens. They provide the highly-detailed but soft, child-friendly 2D vector style required for the RPG.

images.description: Magical academy hero background, use on Landing Page with a white/transparent gradient overlay to ensure text legibility.
Top-down Meadowfall Grove map background. Place clickable Action Tiles (Battle, Hatch, Academy, Collection) floating over this map in the Main Game Hub.
Sunny forest clearing background for the Battle Screen. Characters and Math Questions will overlay this.
Cozy nursery background for the Egg Hatching Progress Screen.

icons.style: Always use thick stroke widths (strokeWidth={3}) and vibrant colors.

pages_and_layout.landing: Hero layout with the generated `hero_bg`. Massive title, floating magical elements, 'Play Now' CTA.
pages_and_layout.onboarding: Card-based sequence. 1. Select Grade (K, 1, 2). 2. Character Creator (using SVG/CSS shapes). 3. Companion Picker (Bento grid of 3 cards for Spriggle, Embercub, Pebblin).
pages_and_layout.main_hub: Full-screen map using `map_meadowfall` background. Floating icons with bounce animations leading to sub-areas. Navbar at top with Player Avatar, Level, and Coins.
pages_and_layout.battle_screen: Split layout over `battle_bg`. Top: Enemy and Player Sprite + HP Bars. Middle: Math Question in a large bold white card. Bottom: 4 large Answer buttons.
pages_and_layout.egg_hatching: Centered large egg on `egg_hatchery_bg`. Progress bar below showing learning activities completed. Egg cracks based on progress.
pages_and_layout.collection: Bento grid of owned companions and silhouetted locked companions.
pages_and_layout.math_academy: List of subjects where companions can be 'assigned' to train. Drag-and-drop feel or simple assignment buttons.
pages_and_layout.parent_dashboard: Gated by PIN modal. Clean, data-dense but friendly dashboard. Stats cards for Accuracy, Time Played, and Subjects.

testing.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, character selectors, math answers, map locations) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="answer-btn-1"`, `data-testid="map-battle-tile"`).
